text:
Liz: heads up — we're planning a non-blocking model swap for embeddings: fallback from 'text-embed-001' -> 'text-embed-002-q4'. Will update docs and redirect examples. Initial PR coming.

Aj: :thumbsup: do we have perf numbers for 002-q4 on small files?

Liz: yes, 002-q4 reduces memory on CPU quantized builds. quick bench pasted below:
```
embed-bench --model text-embed-002-q4 --batch 64
avg_latency_ms: 42
p95: 120
```

Dev-rel-Sam: we need a snippet showing embed usage with v2 SDK change (param rename). I'll add sample to /docs/embeddings/upgrade.md

Kevin: make sure we add a note about the param rename `model` -> `model_name` in the JS SDK — customers hit this.

Liz: good catch. Also: will deprecate old endpoint `/v1/embeddings` on May 15 — adding a redirect and deprecation banner. Need a short comms blurb for marketing.

Mike: Can we do a canary for 10% traffic on Dedicated before full swap? Ops can route.

SRE-Ops: yes, we can route via policy tag `canary:emb-swap-2026`. Need infra PR: github.com/redwood/infra#345 (ops will handle rollout windows).

Aj: docs PR + redirect PR planned. I can own the snippets. Assigning to Aj.

Liz: Aj — please include an example that shows fallback logic:
```
try {
  const embed = await client.embeddings.create({ model_name: 'text-embed-002-q4', input })
  return embed.data
} catch (err) {
  if (err.status === 429 || err.code === 'TIMEOUT') {
    // fallback to earlier model for reliability
    return await client.embeddings.create({ model_name: 'text-embed-001', input })
  }
  throw err
}
```

Dev-rel-Sam: I'll review for clarity and add note about cost delta (002-q4 ~ 0.6x cost in our estimates).

Kevin: ping me when PRs are ready; I'll QA the snippet with TypeScript types and typeshed examples.

Liz: timeline: PRs by EOD Thu, internal canary Mon, public redirect + banner Tue. If any blockers call @here

Doc-bot: Reminder: add `deprecated_models` tag to frontmatter for the pages being sunset.

Liz: thanks everyone. I'll create the PRs and drop links here shortly.
